title: AvtoBaz assistant
subtitle: Searches only listings on AvtoBaz
greeting: Hi! Tell me what you are looking for: a car, a rental, a spare part, a car service or a mechanic. I will search our listings. You can also send a photo of a car, a part or a dashboard warning light.

examples.car: White Toyota from 2018, up to 25 000 AZN in Baku
examples.part: Front brake pads for Kia Sportage 2019
examples.service: Where can I do computer diagnostics in Baku?

disclaimer: The assistant can make mistakes. Check details on the listing page.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many messages. Please try again a little later.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: The message is empty or too long.
errors.INVALID_RESULT: I could not answer that. Try rephrasing your request.
errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: This file can't be used. Send a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.PHOTO_TYPE: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP photos can be sent.
errors.PHOTO_SIZE: The photo is too large. Pick one under 20 MB.
errors.PHOTO_UNREADABLE: This file doesn't open as a photo.

photoReady: Photo attached. Add a question or just send it.
